resolution: All of req_0431 done. (1) Materials strip on move/clone fixed (216fba960): bulk ops spread the whole PlacedBuildPiece minus id, preserving per-face skin + wall edit. (2) Moves grid-lock (dd7199f83). (3) Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y undo+redo for buildings (5f7a6d491): build edits were on a separate worldSession stream the workspace undo didn't cover; now every build commit snapshots the pre-edit state, the workspace snapshot carries this map's pieces, and a history apply reconciles the live worldStream to the snapshot by appending the minimal place/remove events (matched by value since replay mints fresh ids), running on 'history' only so restore/map-switch leaves the stream alone. Same change adds batch commits (commitMany) so a 352-piece move/clone/delete is one snapshot + one undo step instead of freezing.
